data_objects.name: loan_applications
data_objects.meaning: Applicant, household, income, credit-history, requested-loan, and property-area attributes for individual loan applications.
data_objects.notes: Blank cells represent unavailable application attributes.

variables.name: Loan_ID
variables.meaning: Application identifier with an LP-prefixed code.

variables.name: Gender
variables.meaning: Applicant gender category recorded as text.

variables.name: Married
variables.meaning: Yes/No indicator of whether the applicant is married.

variables.name: Dependents
variables.meaning: Number-of-dependents category; the upper category is top-coded as 3+.

variables.name: Education
variables.meaning: Applicant education category distinguishing Graduate from Not Graduate.

variables.name: ApplicantIncome
variables.meaning: Reported applicant income in an unspecified currency and reporting period.

variables.name: CoapplicantIncome
variables.meaning: Reported coapplicant income in the same unspecified basis as ApplicantIncome.

variables.name: LoanAmount
variables.meaning: Requested loan amount in an unspecified currency or scaling convention.

variables.name: Loan_Amount_Term
variables.meaning: Requested loan term expressed in an undocumented time unit.

variables.name: Credit_History
variables.meaning: Binary 0/1 credit-history status code; the label mapping is not supplied.

variables.name: Property_Area
variables.meaning: Property setting category recorded as Urban, Semiurban, or Rural.

structure.description: Each row represents one loan application, and Loan_ID is the application-level candidate key.
Dependents is a categorical count with a 3+ top code; Credit_History is a numeric-looking categorical indicator rather than a measurement.

uncertainties: The currency, income period, loan-amount scale, and loan-term time unit are not declared.
The meanings of the Credit_History values 0 and 1 are not mapped to named statuses in the evidence.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
